welcome.title: Welcome to TextMate!
welcome.content: TextMate is an AI-based text editor that helps you improve your text. All data is processed on local servers of IT BS. You can process special personal data and data that are subject to professional confidentiality (Erhöhter Schutzbedarf) with TextMate. I will now show you the main functions of TextMate.

ribbon.title: The Ribbon
ribbon.content: The ribbon groups actions into two tabs: Transform rewrites your text, and Validate checks it against reference documents.

transform.title: Transform Actions
transform.content: Here are one-click transformations like Summarize, Formality, or Plain Language.

editor.title: Text Editor
editor.content: This is where you write and edit your text. Select a passage to add a note.

wordCount.title: Word Count
wordCount.content: Click here to show detailed information about your text.

textStats.title: Text Statistics
textStats.content: Detailed information about your text including word count, character count, and language level (for German texts).

diffReview.title: Accept or Reject Changes
diffReview.content: When a transformation or fix runs, the changes replace the editor here. All changes must be accepted or rejected before you can continue.

diffAcceptAll.title: Accept All
diffAcceptAll.content: Accepts all changes with one click.

diffDiscardAll.title: Discard All
diffDiscardAll.content: Discards all changes with one click and keeps your original text.

retry.title: Retry Action
retry.content: Discards the suggestion and runs the same action again on your original text.

diffSplitView.title: Switch View
diffSplitView.content: Switch here between inline and split view to compare changes inline or side by side.

validate.title: Validate
validate.content: Switch to the Validate tab to select reference documents and check your text against them.

check.title: Check
check.content: Click here to check your text for errors.

quickActions.title: Rewrite Actions
quickActions.content: Perform text actions such as summaries or rewrites. Select an action to apply it to your text.

customQuickAction.title: Custom Rewrite Instructions
customQuickAction.content: Enter your custom rewrite instructions here to rewrite your text according to your wishes. This is useful when you have special requirements that are not included in the standard actions.
customQuickAction.contentWithLink: Enter your custom rewrite instructions here to rewrite your text according to your wishes. This is useful when you have special requirements that are not included in the standard actions. For tips on writing effective prompts, visit the {link}.

threads.title: Violations & Notes
threads.content: When you run a Check, violations against your reference documents appear here — with reason, proposal, and source. Decide per violation whether to fix it or skip it. With "Apply Fix" the advisor produces the corrected text. You can also add your own notes to any passage of text.
threads.demoReason: This is an example violation shown only during the tour.
threads.demoProposal: The advisor's correction proposal appears here.

conclusion.title: That's it!
conclusion.content: You are now ready to make full use of TextMate. Feel free to restart the tour if you forget something. Have fun writing!

unavailable.title: Onboarding is desktop-only
unavailable.content: The interactive tour isn't available on mobile. Please open TextMate on a desktop device.
